items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: The greatest musicians that I ever played with in my life that gave me the feeling, was Herschel.

ctx.x: 1933, because December 18th, 1933, I will never forget Fletcher Henderson's band coming to Kansas City and Herschel Evans and Lester Young with Ben Webster at the Cherry Blossoms Ballroom, when Coleman Hawkins got drunk and Dickie Wells was right there and laughed at him.
A great player. Because of his trombone playing.

items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: First alto, excellent musician, and he stayed just for a little while and then they picked up Earl Warren out of Cincinnati

ctx.x: First alto, excellent musician, and he stayed just for a little while and then they picked up Earl Warren out of Cincinnati, because Earl Warren I'm pretty sure was playing with Al Sears in Cincinnati at the Ferguson Hotel there.
May I ask you who Caughey Roberts was?
